_README: Recorded Apple Vision body-pose skeletons for the Epic-3 Layer-1 regression test (Issue #21). Frame is Vision NATIVE -- normalized, lower-left origin (y-up), x toward the image's right, anatomical labels -- i.e. the VisionPoseAdapter INPUT, pre-mirror. Each is the output of VNDetectHumanBodyPoseRequest run on the committed shared/native_fixtures/pose_<name>.png (the MPFB CC0 renders, clothed since Issue #27) during Layer-2 calibration; see ios/Tests/VisionCalibrationTests.swift and shared/native_fixtures/NATIVE-FIXTURES.md. Replayed through VisionPoseAdapter, these must satisfy the same invariants.json the live calibration asserts -- the fast, camera-free, per-commit guard on the iOS adapter (the Layer-2 test re-derives them live on a real device; body pose does not run on the iOS Simulator). Values are [x, y, confidence], captured at 4-decimal precision by the host extractor ios/Tools/extract_vision_skeleton.swift (NATIVE-FIXTURES.md section 6). Regenerate by re-running shared/tools/gen_native_fixtures.py and then 'swift ios/Tools/extract_vision_skeleton.swift shared/native_fixtures/pose_<name>.png' against the committed images.
_frame: Vision native: normalized [0,1], lower-left origin (y-up), x to image right, anatomical L/R labels.
